invariants: List path unchanged: no canonical hydration or review recovery waits.
One current section and contiguous review watermark; no growing argument assembly.
No confirmation until every section was reached and explicit acknowledgement recorded.
Version, tenant/account, generation, proposal/tool and argument-reference checks; pinned preflight immediately before decision.
Account replacement/chat switch cancel late reads and preflight dispatch.
Read/receipt response bounds enforced separately from 8192 Unicode code point section size.
Durable native intent contains only identity and hashes, survives restart, and never saves argument sections.
Existing custom domain review loaders and permission predicates remain authoritative.
Projection summary upgrades use bounded authorized background work and append/deletion fences.
limitations: Local fixtures and source compiles do not establish production deployment or consumer installation.
Formatting an explicitly selected oversized argument in PostgreSQL still scales with that individual argument size.
Custom non-hash opaque references need the authorized host review resolver.
Custom consumer inbox placement/domain presentation and published-pin adoption remain later work.
Broader goal audit and remaining recovery/context qualification are still open.
